title: U.S. Standard Atmosphere temperature and density vs. height plots (appendix)
description: Two Mathcad-style graphs with green gridlines plotted against height from 0 to 1×10^5 m. The upper plot shows T_atm(height) in kelvin starting near 288 K, dipping to about 217 K, rising to roughly 230 K near 30 km, then declining linearly toward zero at 100 km. The lower plot shows density ρ_atm(height) decaying from about 1.2 kg/m^3 at sea level to near zero by roughly 30 km.
